_fixture.note: FIXTURE, not a live index. A derived cohort preserving the baseline records named in derived_from, with exact selected descriptive records from the pinned upstream index. Only --use-fixture accepts this file; it must never be deployed.

graphs.title: Chinook music store
graphs.description: What the Chinook sample database means: a digital music store that sells tracks to customers in 24 countries. Each concept is bound to the ModelSpec entity or property that holds it; concepts that are not specific to Chinook are reused from the core concepts.

graphs.title: MeaningGraph core concepts
graphs.description: Universal concepts that are not specific to any dataset (country, currency, customer, invoice, price, revenue, date, population, per capita and more), plus the meaning/draft-1 schema and format reference. Dataset graphs reuse them by address and pin a commit.

graphs.title: ECB daily euro foreign exchange reference quotes
graphs.description: Preparatory source meanings for native time, currency and rate strings from the ECB daily XML resource. Reference date has no publication instant; the indicative rate expresses quote-currency units per one EUR with lexical digits preserved. No stable cross-read identity, synthetic EUR row, reciprocal, historical lookup or accepted country/tender/transaction join is asserted. CC0 covers authored metadata only; ECB rate reuse terms remain separate. Source execution and paid applicability stay blocked.

graphs.title: GeoNames source projection
graphs.description: Source-qualified GeoNames countries, places, admin1 and alternate names, retaining native keys, historic country rows and unresolved references. Auxiliary demo country bridges preserve separate source property scopes; their target bindings alone do not authorize raw-label interoperability. Model and meaning metadata are CC0-1.0; source GeoNames data is CC-BY-4.0.

graphs.title: Research Organization Registry source projection
graphs.description: Accepted public source roles for the complete ROR schema 2 organizations recordset, retaining native URL identity, all statuses and ordered location and relationship projections. Source bindings do not authorize user field mappings or name-to-identity matching. Model and meaning metadata are CC0-1.0; embedded GeoNames data remains CC-BY-4.0 under the provider attribution.
